MONGODB_URL.description: MongoDB connection string for database storage

PANEL_KEY.description: Secret shared with your public panel. When set, /api/code only answers the panel.

PANEL_URL.description: Public panel address. Visitors who open this server's own address are sent there.

SESSION_ENC_KEY.description: Secret text (16+ characters) used to encrypt WhatsApp sessions saved in MongoDB. Keep a copy: without it saved sessions cannot be restored.

GLOBAL_OWNER_CONTROL.description: Set to false so the bot owner has no control over other people's linked accounts.
